title: Postpartum early rehabilitation for symptom reduction of pelvic organ prolaps
summary: The study aims to investigate pelvic floor rehabilitation through pessary therapy (Arabin Hybrid Pessary) after childbirth. The women will be recruited postpartum on the maternity ward of the University Women's Hospital Ulm. The goal is to include 50 women. The women will receive a pelvic floor check-up 2-3 weeks postpartum, and the Arabin Hybrid Pessary will be fitted. Follow-up appointments will take place 4 weeks and 6 months postpartum. At each appointment, the women will complete questionnaires regarding handling and effectiveness via an online survey. The primary study objective is the subjective change in the feeling of prolapse through the use of the pessary.

interventions.name: Women are asked on the maternity wards postpartum whether they experience symptoms of pelvic floor descent and/or a wide hiatus. criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
women with symptoms of pelvic organ prolaps postpartum
Exclusion criteria:
Retained placental tissue (ultrasound finding)
Infection (laboratory evidence: elevated leukocytes and/or CRP)
Wound dehiscence (clinical finding)
Edema formation (clinical finding)
Language barrier
Insufficient ability to change the pessary independently
